title: StarterGui vs PlayerGui (GUI not showing)
summary: StarterGui is a TEMPLATE folder — clients copy its contents into each Player.PlayerGui at spawn. Code that toggles/reads GUIs must target PlayerGui (the live copy). Edits to StarterGui at runtime don't show.

explanation.whatItIs: Blueprint vs building: StarterGui stores the blueprint; PlayerGui holds the building the player actually sees.
explanation.whyItExists: Each player needs their own UI state (health, inventory); copying from a shared template at spawn gives fresh per-player state.
symptoms: Setting Visible=true on a StarterGui frame — nothing happens on screen
Finding GUI children in StarterGui but the UI stays hidden
Changes 'work' in Studio's Start but not live clients (or vice versa)
explanation.fix: From LocalScripts use player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"); design in StarterGui, interact with PlayerGui. Remember ResetOnSpawn re-copies some GUIs.
tips: In a LocalScript: local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn=false keeps runtime changes across respawns
commonMistakes: Server scripts trying to modify StarterGui expecting live results
Caching the StarterGui instance and wondering why UI state resets

examples.title: Right target
examples.code:
-- ❌ Blueprint editing (invisible to everyone):
-- game.StarterGui.Menu.Visible = true

-- ✅ Live copy:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local menu = playerGui:WaitForChild("Menu")
menu.Enabled = true
